cards.title: Should You Let Your Teen Play Grand Theft Auto VI?
cards.body: GTA VI is rated 18 and contains extreme violence, sex, and drug use that experts say isn't appropriate for children. Parents should be aware of the game's explicit content before their teens play it.

cards.title: Medical Sharenting: Who Owns a Child's Medical Story?
cards.body: Children often have no say in decisions about sharing their medical stories online. Experts say kids need agency to decide how illness fits into their identity as they grow.

cards.title: When Did Tracking Our Teenagers Become Normal?
cards.body: As parents increasingly monitor their teens, it's important to balance safety concerns with giving kids space to develop independence. Learning to let go matters for both teens and parents.

cards.title: Early Stress Can Change Your Brain
cards.body: New research shows past stress rewires how the brain responds to future stressors, heightening sensitivity. Understanding this can help parents support children who've experienced early adversity.

cards.title: Blended Families: Making It Work With Ex's Family
cards.body: Expert tips explain how to build positive relationships with your child's half-siblings' parents. Many blended families find that cooperation and respect benefit the children most.
